record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: Frontier advanced from R55 raw fanout observation to R56 executable replication closure. Exact ALIVE subject 203fc7fe67ce6756ced1f68ba52bc883304cfc64 provides 50 reusable qualification sensors and observes two full-replication-ready consumers from four grounded subjects; shortfall to 10x consumer fanout is 8. Next highest-value frontier is target-local adapters plus receipt-return/dependency/projection closure for admitted-but-not-ready consumers, then discovery of new orthogonal writable consumers. PR #272 is technically merge-admissible but draft-state transition is connector-refused.
